concept: One night, one key light: follow a leaked password as a lit key card through a dark building of doors, watch which doors it opens, then replay the same night with the two habits in place and watch every door hold.

cast.name: Dana
cast.note: one fictional employee, never drawn as a figure: shown only through her screen, her phone, her desk (no S3 noir cast exists yet, style guide section 8)

devices.what: the password as a small lit key card, the one amber thing in the night: lifted out of the screen, copied onto a list, tried at doors; a fresh card per door in the replay
systems as doors in a dark wall: Shop and Work side by side, a corridor that opens one door after another, a heavier last door; a second lock under the first for MFA
the 02:00 work sign-in on a monitor in a dark office, opener and payoff: Login successful at the open, Access denied in the replay
Dana's phone on a dark nightstand: Approve? prompts, Deny pressed, MFA on in the morning, one denied prompt in the replay
join material: slow camera moves inside the night; a dip through black for a new place or time, a hard cut at a section boundary

value_script.why: the cold open: one key light on the screen
rewind to the evening the password was reused, a touch warmer
the mechanism: leaked, tried, spread; light spilling through doors is the harm
morning light on the desk: the actions, the lesson's one lift
the opening night replayed, calm: every door shut

parts.what: the password as a physical key card about 220 x 140 px at its hero size, a notched edge (its 'teeth' are the password), a faint amber glow under 200 px across: the one accent in the frame. States: lit (amber edge and glow), copy (a duller duplicate, muted edge, for the list and the stream), dim (rejected: glow off), fresh (a different notch pattern, ink edge, issued by the vault). Drawable at several sizes and rotations.

a door set in a dark wall, seen square on, surface and surface2 with a rim on the key side, a lock plate with a card slot, an optional small name plate (Inter, ink, 30 px or more). States: shut, turning (the card in the slot, the lock turns), cracked (open a hand's width, a hard wedge of ink key light spilling onto the floor), forced (askew on its hinges, a splintered edge, a neg mark), refused (the card in the slot does not turn, a small neg cross on the plate), second_lock (a second lock plate below the first, shut, with a small phone glyph waiting). A variant 'heavy' (wider, banded, a heavier lock) for the privileged last door. Must work at hero size (one door 360 px wide) and in a receding row (a corridor of 6 to 8 doors in perspective).

a monitor on a desk in a dark office, seen from a three-quarter front so its screen reads, a warm key light from a desk lamp (R2b), the screen a dark sign-in pane: work sign-in title, a username field reading dana, a password field that fills with dots, a status line. States: empty, typing (dots fill), success (status 'Login successful' in ink with a quiet tick), denied (status 'Access denied' in ink on a pos underline: the good outcome here). A clock reading 02:00 sits on the screen's top bar. Screen text 30 px or larger on screen.

a phone lying on a nightstand in a dark bedroom (a nightstand edge, a lamp off, a dark pillow edge at most: no person), screen up and tilted so it reads. States: dark, prompt (screen lights cool: 'Approve?' title with Approve and Deny buttons, Deny drawn so it can be the accent), denied (Deny pressed, then a small 'Reported' line in pos), mfa_on (a calm screen in daylight: 'MFA on' with a tick). Also drawable without the nightstand (on a desk, or as a small glyph on a lock). Prompt words 30 px or larger after scale.

a small password manager as a closed safe or vault box, surface with an ink rim, that slides out a fresh key card for each door (one card per door, each with its own notch pattern). States: closed, issuing (a card slides out), done. The label 'password manager' is drawn by the scene, not the part.

props.title: Right password. So who logged in?

design.treatment: the cold open picture: a night office on a depth stage, one desk lamp key light on a monitor that shows the 02:00 sign-in already succeeded; then the password becomes an object: a lit key card rises out of the password field into the dark and the camera follows it right toward a far wall of closed doors at the back of the stage; push 0.06, drift -26
design.why_motion: turning the password into a thing the viewer can follow is the lesson's device

beat_sheet.action: 02:00 on the top bar, the dots filled, 'Login successful' under the key light; nothing forced, nothing broken
the card lifts out of the password field and floats right, its amber edge the brightest thing
a row of closed doors appears far back in the dark, the card turning toward them

design.continuity: b03 is a camera move to the corridor, where the same keycard (kit) meets the doors; b14 replays this exact shot

design.treatment: rewind to dusk: the wall of doors lit slightly warmer (mid band), two doors centred side by side with name plates Shop and Work, the card fitting each in turn; plain, no blame
design.why_motion: one card fitting two doors shows reuse as a picture

beat_sheet.action: a small accent4 kicker 'Months ago' on dark field top left
the card appears between the two doors
the card slides into the Shop lock, it turns, the card withdraws
the same card into the Work lock, it turns, withdraws

design.continuity: b04 to b06 continue here: hold door_wall, door_shop, door_work and keycard; the rewind_tag leaves at the end

design.treatment: back to night (dark band): the Shop door is forced in shadow; the card is copied onto a long list sheet of other copy cards that slides away out of frame; the Work door stays dark and untouched
design.why_motion: a breach elsewhere becoming a list that travels is the sequence the learner must see

beat_sheet.action: the Shop door goes to forced; a neg tag 'Shop: breached' on the dark side with a lead
the Work door stays shut and dim, untouched
a copy of the card drops onto a long sheet of copy cards
the sheet slides right and out, duplicated twice as it goes

design.continuity: b05 holds door_wall, door_shop, door_work and keycard; door_shop stays forced; breach_tag and list_sheet leave

design.treatment: the wall extends into a row of login doors; a machine-steady stream of copy cards is tried at each door, one after another, at an even indifferent rhythm; the term appears once while the stream runs
design.why_motion: the automation is the definition: the even rhythm says no person chose her

beat_sheet.action: copy cards slide in from the left and stop at each lock in turn, each refused, steady tempo
'credential stuffing' in ink, title role, on dark field above the row with an accent underline
Dana's lit card arrives in the stream like any other, heading for the Work door

design.continuity: b06 holds door_wall, door_work, keycard and card_stream at rest; term leaves

design.treatment: push in on the Work door: Dana's card turns the lock, the door opens a crack and a hard wedge of light spills across the floor; hold on the open door
design.why_motion: the one turn that works is the consequence of reuse

beat_sheet.action: the card goes into the slot and turns
the door cracks open, a wedge of ink light falls on the floor
a neg tag 'reused' on the dark side, lead to the card

design.continuity: b07 zooms through the open crack into the nested station 'inside'

design.treatment: inside the door: a dark security desk, a lit sign-in log pane (Loom.ui doc or a bespoke table, 1100 px or wider, on a lit plane) listing sign-ins at 08:57, 12:14, 17:40 and 02:00, all user dana, all 'success', all the same ink; nothing flags the 02:00 row
design.why_motion: the sameness is the point: a valid login looks normal

beat_sheet.action: the rows build in reading order
the 02:00 row gets a faint accent mark that fades again; no alert appears

design.continuity: camera to the hall station next; nothing held

design.treatment: a long hall of doors receding in perspective from the first open door; one door after another opens in sequence down the line, each spilling its wedge of light; at the end a heavier banded door is tried
design.why_motion: the light spreading door to door is lateral movement

beat_sheet.action: doors 2, 3, 4 crack open in sequence, light wedges joining
'lateral movement' in ink, title role, on the dark upper third with an accent underline
the heavy door at the end is tried: its lock rattles, a neg edge

design.continuity: b09 continues: hold hall_set, hall_doors and heavy_door; the term leaves

design.treatment: pull back wide on the hall of open doors; two numbered tags mark the two places the night could have stopped: 1 'Leaked password at the login' on the first door, 2 'Correct password, wrong person' on the moment past it; a quiet pause bar for the 2 s question
design.why_motion: a held, finished frame for the viewer to choose

beat_sheet.action: slow pull back to show every open door
tag 1 on the first door, lead to its lock
tag 2 beside it; the question 'Which habit shuts which door?' on dark field; pause bar runs through the silence

design.continuity: camera back to the corridor for the replay

design.treatment: replay the leak with a different card per door: the vault issues a fresh card to Shop and another to Work; the Shop card is copied as before and tried at the Work door: refused, it does not turn
design.why_motion: seeing the copied card fail at Work is the habit's proof

beat_sheet.action: the vault slides out two different cards, one to each door; tag 'unique password'
the Shop card is copied and tried at Work: refused state, dims
label 'password manager' beside the vault, lead to it

design.treatment: push in on the Work door: a stolen card turns the first lock, but a second lock below stays shut, a small phone glyph on it waiting for a code; the door holds
design.why_motion: the first lock turning and the door still holding is MFA in one picture

beat_sheet.action: a second lock plate appears below the first
'MFA' in ink, title role, on dark field
the stolen card turns the first lock
the second lock stays shut; the door does not move

design.continuity: a camera move down to the bedroom: the second lock's phone glyph is answered by the phone there

design.treatment: the dark bedroom: the phone on the nightstand lights cool with an Approve? prompt, again and again (three prompts stacking); Deny is pressed and a 'Reported' line appears; a 1 s pause for recall
design.why_motion: the repetition is the attack; the press is the move

beat_sheet.action: first Approve? prompt lights the screen
two more prompts stack, the screen pulsing on each
Deny carries the accent
Deny pressed, the stack clears, 'Reported' in pos

design.treatment: morning light (the lesson's light band) on Dana's desk, a lit plane across it; three objects in a row, each lit as it is named with a plain label: a fresh key card 'Replace reused passwords', the phone in mfa_on state 'Turn on MFA', a sent report note 'Report odd prompts'
design.why_motion: the actions arrive one by one as she says them

beat_sheet.action: a fresh card comes out of the vault onto the desk; label
the phone shows MFA on; label
a report note slides off toward the security team; label in accent

design.continuity: a cut back to the b02 office at night

design.treatment: the b02 shot again, 02:00, one key light: the leaked card is tried and fits nothing, an inset of the dark nightstand phone lights once and is denied, the screen reads Access denied; the far doors stay dark and shut; slow pull back
design.why_motion: the same night with nothing opening is the payoff

beat_sheet.action: 02:00 warms on as in b02
the copy card dims at the field; nothing turns
the inset phone lights once, Deny, Reported
Access denied on the screen; far doors dark; pull back
